player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Motambwisi {player_id} na mokili ya Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Elembo na yo ezali '{symbol}'.
Mokono ezali koevita kobwaka misatu na ndelo moko (na mbala, na njibu, to na diagonal).
Soki okobwaka misatu na ndelo moko, ozui.
Sambisa kobwaka na formati '[4]' mpo na kobwaka elembo na yo na seli 4.
Tango ozali Motambwisi {player_id}, ozali '{symbol}' mpe motambwisi ya mpambani na yo ezali '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formate ya kobaluka ezali na ntina te. Salela "[cell]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Index ya baselile oyo ezali na ntina te.

game_action.placed: Mokeli {player_id} akeli symbole na ye ({symbol}) na cellule {cell}.
